title: Voice AI Call → Transcript → Summary → CRM & Follow-up

sections.label: 1 · CALL ENDS
sections.note: The voice platform posts the completed call the moment it hangs up — recording, transcript and metadata in one payload. Nothing is polled.

sections.label: 2 · UNDERSTAND
sections.note: The transcript is read for outcome, objections raised, next step agreed and any commitment made on the call. Structured output means these land as fields, not a paragraph someone has to re-read.

sections.label: 3 · OUTCOME
sections.note: Booked calls create the deal and the calendar hold. Objections route to the right follow-up sequence. Wrong numbers and voicemails are marked and dropped without touching the pipeline.

sections.label: 4 · WRITE BACK
sections.note: Everything lands on the contact record — transcript link, summary, outcome and next step — so the next person to touch this lead sees the whole call without listening to it.

input_sample.transcript_preview: AI: Hi, is this Wes? … Wes: Yeah, we had some shingles come off in the storm last month but I already had one guy out …

output_sample.summary: Storm damage from last month's hail, already had one contractor look at it but no work scheduled and no written estimate. Wants a second opinion before filing with insurance. Agreed to a free inspection Thursday morning.
objections: already had someone look at it

commitments.what: Have the insurance claim number ready

output_sample.next_step: Inspection Thu 9am — assigned to field team
